overview_description.description:
Quippy: The Oral Practice Language Learning Tool for Teachers 

Quippy empowers teachers to create interactive speaking activities that deliver real-time pronunciation feedback and detailed performance reports—helping students build confidence in their language skills. 

Assign speaking exercises effortlessly, monitor student progress, and provide personalized support. Whether you’re teaching Mandarin, English, or any other language, Quippy makes speaking practice exciting and productive for learners of all levels. 

For publishers, Quippy offers robust e-publishing capabilities to transform traditional textbooks into dynamic, AI-powered resources, making language learning more interactive and impactful. 

Revolutionize your teaching and equip your students with the tools they need to succeed. Start using Quippy today!
